mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that find no analogy in creatures."
The incommunicable are those that find no analogy in creatures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that find analogy in the creatures."
The communicable attributes are those that find analogy in the creatures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sign of a person b e a r i n g it."
A name is a sign of a person b e a r i n g it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only source for an accurate knowledge of him, and then only when this revelation results in a personal relationship with God."
God's special revelation is the only source for an accurate knowledge of him, and then only when this revelation results in a personal relationship with God.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means what the Bible says about the earth and history is completely trustworthy."
Inspiration means what the Bible says about the earth and history is completely trustworthy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important question of human existence."
The existence of God is the most important question of human existence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the key doctrines of the Bible."
The doctrine of the Holy Scripture is one of the key doctrines of the Bible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means having a relationship with him."
Knowing God means having a relationship with him.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a testimony about God and can augment and strengthen our faith even though they are not grounds of faith and cannot induce faith."
Rational arguments are a testimony about God and can augment and strengthen our faith even though they are not grounds of faith and cannot induce faith.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means he has no origin and he is not answerable to any one while self-self-sufficient means God has no needs and depends on no one."
Self-existent means he has no origin and he is not answerable to any one while self-self-sufficient means God has no needs and depends on no one.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means God is who he is, he is the same yesterday, today and forever."
The name I AM means God is who he is, he is the same yesterday, today and forever.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the belief that the Bible is fully true in all its teaching or affirms and in all of this it is without admixture of error."
Inerrancy is the belief that the Bible is fully true in all its teaching or affirms and in all of this it is without admixture of error.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means God can be worshipped anywhere."
The implication of God's omnipresence means God can be worshipped anywhere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a scientific or philosophical theory known as Materialistic Monism."
Theoretical atheism is a scientific or philosophical theory known as Materialistic Monism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the personification of God's word (John1:1ff; Rev. 19:13)."
Jesus Christ is the personification of God's word (John1:1ff; Rev. 19:13).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered part of God's revelation. 8."
Explain why attributes are considered part of God's revelation. 8.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means Lord, Master, the name of God used for Yahweh when the proper name of God came to be taught of as too sacred to be pronounced."
Adonai means Lord, Master, the name of God used for Yahweh when the proper name of God came to be taught of as too sacred to be pronounced.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Revelation of God's words in actions."
The Bible is the Revelation of God's words in actions.

practical atheist

awareness

Absolute
Absolute refers to the essence of God as considered in itself.

Jewish Philosopher Spinoza

created world

climax of God's revelation

effects

person

Deism

Hebrew word for name literally

God
